pairs.target: chē yídòng , lín zhào jiù ànzhù le shēnbiān de mùxiāng .
pairs.english: As soon as the cart moved, Lin Zhao braced the wooden box beside her.
pairs.hanzi: 车一动，林照就按住了身边的木箱。

pairs.target: shàngpō shí xiāngzǐ wǎng tā zhè tóu huá , chēfū tīngjiàn xiǎngdòng , huíshǒu rēng lái yìtuán jiù mábù .
pairs.english: On the uphill stretch the box slid toward her, and the driver heard the noise and tossed back a wad of old hemp cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 上坡时箱子往她这头滑，车夫听见响动，回手扔来一团旧麻布。

pairs.target: tā bǎ bùsāijìn xiāng jiǎodǐ xià , yòu jiāng shuǐnáng yí dào xī jiān .
pairs.english: She stuffed the cloth under the foot of the box and moved the waterskin between her knees.
pairs.hanzi: 她把布塞进箱脚底下，又将水囊移到膝间。

pairs.target: yílùshang zàiyǒu diānbǒ , tā zhǐguǎn fúzhù xiāng yán , búbì cìcì ná yāo qù dǐng .
pairs.english: When the cart jolted again along the way, she only had to hold the edge of the box, without catching it against her waist each time.
pairs.hanzi: 一路上再有颠簸，她只管扶住箱沿，不必次次拿腰去顶。

pairs.target: guò le héwān , tiāncái liàng tòu .
pairs.english: It was only past the bend in the river that daylight came fully.
pairs.hanzi: 过了河湾，天才亮透。

pairs.target: lì jīn de chéngqiáng lùchū lái , qiánggēn xià yǒu yìliū tiāodàn de rén , zǒu dé bǐ chē hái kuài .
pairs.english: Lijin's city wall came into view, with a line of people carrying shoulder poles along its foot, walking even faster than the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 砾津的城墙露出来，墙根下有一溜挑担的人，走得比车还快。

pairs.target: yǒurén dān le mǎnmǎn liǎngkuāng qīngcài , dào le méndòng qián cái fàngxià xiējiān ,
pairs.english: One person carried two baskets brimming with greens and set them down to rest their shoulders only at the gate passage.
pairs.hanzi: 有人担了满满两筐青菜，到了门洞前才放下歇肩，

pairs.target: càiyè shàng de shuǐ shùnzhe kuāng dǐ wǎngxiàdī .
pairs.english: Water dripped from the leaves down through the basket bottoms.
pairs.hanzi: 菜叶上的水顺着筐底往下滴。

pairs.target: chēfū zài xīmén lǐ tíng le chē , zhǐ gěi tā kàn xiàjiǎo de shíjiē .
pairs.english: The driver stopped the cart just inside the west gate and showed her the stone step to use.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫在西门里停了车，指给她看下脚的石阶。

pairs.target: lín zhào xiān bǎ jiǎo fàngxiàqù , cǎi shí le , zài jiē tā dì lái de yāodài hé shuǐnáng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao lowered her feet first, planted them firmly, then took the pouch and waterskin he handed her.
pairs.hanzi: 林照先把脚放下去，踩实了，再接他递来的腰袋和水囊。

pairs.target: " duōxiè . "
pairs.english: “Many thanks.”
pairs.hanzi: “多谢。”

pairs.target: chēfū bǎibǎishǒu , cuī zhe shēngkǒu wǎngqiánzǒu .
pairs.english: The driver waved a hand and urged the animal to go onward.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫摆摆手，催着牲口往前走。

pairs.target: lín zhàozhàn zài yuándì , děng nà zhèn chēlún shēng hùnjìn jiēshàng de xiǎngdòng lǐ , cái jiāng yāodài xì huí shēnshàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao stood in place until the sound of the wheels merged into the street noise, then tied the pouch back on her waist.
pairs.hanzi: 林照站在原地，等那阵车轮声混进街上的响动里，才将腰袋系回身上。

pairs.target: tā zhīdào zěnme zǒu .
pairs.english: She knew the way.
pairs.hanzi: 她知道怎么走。

pairs.target: guò liǎngjiā yóu pù , yán shígōu wǎng hébiān qù , zài guǎijìn liàng yīshang de nàtiáo xiàng .
pairs.english: Past two oil shops, along the stone gutter toward the river, then turn into the lane where the laundry hung.
pairs.hanzi: 过两家油铺，沿石沟往河边去，再拐进晾衣裳的那条巷。

pairs.target: wǎngcháng gǎnzhe shànggōng , zhè jǐduàn lù hái búgòu tā chī wán yìzhāng bǐng .
pairs.english: When she hurried to work as usual, the walk was too short for her to finish a flatbread.
pairs.hanzi: 往常赶着上工，这几段路还不够她吃完一张饼。

pairs.target: zhètiān tā zài dìèrjiā yóu pù de yánxià zhàn le hǎo yízhèn ,
pairs.english: Today she stood for a good while under the eaves of the second oil shop,
pairs.hanzi: 这天她在第二家油铺的檐下站了好一阵，

pairs.target: děng jiǎobèi nà gǔ tiào tòng huǎn guòqù , cái gǎn bǎ quánshēn de fènliàng zài jiāogěi nà zhī jiǎo .
pairs.english: waiting for the throbbing in her instep to ease before she dared put her full weight on that foot again.
pairs.hanzi: 等脚背那股跳痛缓过去，才敢把全身的分量再交给那只脚。

pairs.target: xiàngkǒu de chǎo dòu tān gāng zhī qǐlái .
pairs.english: The roasted-bean stall at the mouth of the lane had only just gone up.
pairs.hanzi: 巷口的炒豆摊刚支起来。

alignment.english: at the mouth of the lane

pairs.target: tānzhǔ ná chǎnzǐ guā guōdǐ ,
pairs.english: The vendor scraped the pan bottom with a spatula.
pairs.hanzi: 摊主拿铲子刮锅底，

pairs.target: lín zhào tīngjiàn nà shúxī de liǎngshēng guā xiǎng , shǒu biàn wǎng yāodài shàng mōlemō .
pairs.english: At those two familiar scrapes, Lin Zhao's hand went to her pouch.
pairs.hanzi: 林照听见那熟悉的两声刮响，手便往腰袋上摸了摸。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn liúgěi tā de nà bāo dòuzǐ hái zài , gé zhe bù , yǐjīng niē bù chū yuánlái nàge fāngfāngzhèngzhèng de jiǎo le .
pairs.english: The packet of beans Aunt Zhou had left her was still there. Through the cloth she could no longer feel the neat square corner it once had.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶留给她的那包豆子还在，隔着布，已经捏不出原来那个方方正正的角了。

pairs.target: zǒu dào liàngyīshéng xiàmiàn , tā táiqǐ yǎn .
pairs.english: When she reached the space under the clothesline, she raised her eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 走到晾衣绳下面，她抬起眼。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn jiā de mén kāi zhe .
pairs.english: The door to Aunt Zhou's home stood open.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶家的门开着。

pairs.target: xiǎo dèng zài ménwài , zhōu shěn què méi zuò , fú zhe ménkuàng zhàn zài nàér .
pairs.english: The little stool was outside the door, but Aunt Zhou hadn't sat down. She stood there holding the doorframe.
pairs.hanzi: 小凳在门外，周婶却没坐，扶着门框站在那儿。

pairs.target: lín zhào zhāng le zhāngzuǐ , hái méi jiào chū shēng , xiān kànjiàn ménkǎn lìngyìbiān yǒu gèrén bǎshǒu cóng xiùlǐ chōu le chūlái .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao opened her mouth, but before she called out, she first saw someone on the other side of the threshold draw a hand from his sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 林照张了张嘴，还没叫出声，先看见门槛另一边有个人把手从袖里抽了出来。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟。

pairs.target: tā tuì dào qiángbiān , jiān zhuàng zài yìgēn chēng yīshéng de zhúgān shàng .
pairs.english: She backed up to the wall, her shoulder knocking into a bamboo pole that propped up the clothesline.
pairs.hanzi: 她退到墙边，肩撞在一根撑衣绳的竹竿上。

pairs.target: gāntóu huàng le huàng .
pairs.english: The top of the pole wobbled.
pairs.hanzi: 竿头晃了晃。

pairs.target: tā shēnshǒu zuàn zhù , tóudǐng liàngzhe de shī yīshang cā guò tā de liǎn , liángyì yìzhí tiē dào ěrgēn .
pairs.english: She reached out and gripped it. The wet clothes hanging overhead brushed her face, the chill reaching all the way to her ears.
pairs.hanzi: 她伸手攥住，头顶晾着的湿衣裳擦过她的脸，凉意一直贴到耳根。

pairs.target: " tā shì zài nǎér luò de shuǐ ? "
pairs.english: “Where did she fall into the water?”
pairs.hanzi: “她是在哪儿落的水？”

pairs.target: zhōu shěn wèn .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou asked.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶问。

pairs.target: " huíláng nàbiān .
pairs.english: “By the gallery.
pairs.hanzi: “回廊那边。

pairs.target: wǒmen pài rén xiàqù zhǎo guò , shuǐ tài jí . "
pairs.english: We sent people down to look, but the current was too fast.”
pairs.hanzi: 我们派人下去找过，水太急。”

pairs.target: lín zhào wò zhe gānzǐ , tīngjiàn zìjǐ de xiédǐ zài shíbǎn shàng qīngqīng cèng le yíxià .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao held the pole and heard her own shoe give a soft scrape on the flagstone.
pairs.hanzi: 林照握着竿子，听见自己的鞋底在石板上轻轻蹭了一下。

pairs.target: huíláng nàbiān .
pairs.english: By the gallery.
pairs.hanzi: 回廊那边。

pairs.target: nà zhī shǒutuī zài tā shēnshàng de shíhòu , lí shuǐ háiyǒu nàme cháng yíduàn .
pairs.english: When that hand shoved her, the water had still been such a long way below.
pairs.hanzi: 那只手推在她身上的时候，离水还有那么长一段。

pairs.target: " nín ruòxiǎng qù kànkàn , wǒ jiào rén dàilù . "
pairs.english: “If you would like to see the place, I will send someone to show you the way.”
pairs.hanzi: “您若想去看看，我叫人带路。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu de shēngyīn yòu xiǎng qǐlái ,
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou's voice came again.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟的声音又响起来，

pairs.target: " zhè jǐrì jiālǐ quēshénme , yě zhǐguǎn shuō . "
pairs.english: “If there's anything your household needs these next few days, just say so.”
pairs.hanzi: “这几日家里缺什么，也只管说。”

pairs.target: zhōu shěn méi dāying , yě méi dàoxiè .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou neither agreed nor thanked him.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶没答应，也没道谢。

pairs.target: tā dītóu bǎ xiǎo dèng wǎng mén lǐ nuó le yìdiǎn , dèng jiǎo kǎ zài ménkǎn shàng , tā yòu tí le yícì .
pairs.english: She lowered her head and moved the little stool a bit toward the inside. One leg caught on the threshold, and she lifted it once again.
pairs.hanzi: 她低头把小凳往门里挪了一点，凳脚卡在门槛上，她又提了一次。

pairs.target: lín zhào chàyìdiǎn jiù wǎngqiánzǒu le .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao almost went forward.
pairs.hanzi: 林照差一点就往前走了。

pairs.target: nà zhāng dèngzǐ hěn qīng , zhōu shěn yòng yìzhī shǒu biàn néng līn qǐlái , píngrì lǐ tā gēnběn búhuì qù bāng .
pairs.english: The stool was so light Aunt Zhou could lift it with one hand, and on an ordinary day Lin Zhao wouldn't have helped at all.
pairs.hanzi: 那张凳子很轻，周婶用一只手便能拎起来，平日里她根本不会去帮。

pairs.target: kě zhèhuìer tā xiǎng guòqù dā yíxiàshǒu , xiǎng tīng zhōu shěn xián tā àishì , ràng tā bǎ shuǐnáng fàngxià zài lái .
pairs.english: But now she wanted to go over and lend a hand, wanted to hear Aunt Zhou complain that she was in the way and tell her to set down her waterskin before coming over.
pairs.hanzi: 可这会儿她想过去搭一下手，想听周婶嫌她碍事，让她把水囊放下再来。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu hái zhàn zài ménwài .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou was still standing outside the door.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟还站在门外。

pairs.target: tā bù zhīdào tā zài děng shénme .
pairs.english: She didn't know what he was waiting for.
pairs.hanzi: 她不知道他在等什么。

pairs.target: yěxǔ zhǐ děng zhōu shěn shuō yíjù huà , yěxǔ hái xiǎng kànkàn zhè shànmén lǐ yǒuméiyǒu rén huílái .
pairs.english: Maybe he was only waiting for Aunt Zhou to say something. Maybe he also wanted to see whether anyone came back through that door.
pairs.hanzi: 也许只等周婶说一句话，也许还想看看这扇门里有没有人回来。

pairs.target: zhǐyào tā yì kāikǒu , tā biàn huì zhīdào .
pairs.english: The moment she spoke, he would know.
pairs.hanzi: 只要她一开口，他便会知道。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn zhōngyú bǎ dèngzǐ tíjìnqù le .
pairs.english: At last Aunt Zhou lifted the stool into the house.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶终于把凳子提进去了。

pairs.target: mén réng kāi zhe , lín zhào kàndéjiàn ménkǎn shàng nà kuài bèi xiédǐ móliàng de mùtou .
pairs.english: The door was still open. Lin Zhao could see the patch of wood on the threshold polished by shoe soles.
pairs.hanzi: 门仍开着，林照看得见门槛上那块被鞋底磨亮的木头。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zuàn zhe zhúgān de shǒu sōngkāi , yíbù yibù tuìhuí xiàngkǒu .
pairs.english: She unclenched the hand that held the bamboo pole and backed toward the mouth of the lane, one step at a time.
pairs.hanzi: 她把攥着竹竿的手松开，一步一步退回巷口。

pairs.target: tiěguō cái rè , chǎo dòu de rén zhèng wǎng lǐ dào shā .
pairs.english: The iron pan was only just hot, and the bean vendor was pouring sand into it.
pairs.hanzi: 铁锅才热，炒豆的人正往里倒沙。

pairs.target: lín zhào cóng tā shēnhòu ràoguòqù , méi zài táitóu kàn nàtiáo xiàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao passed behind him and didn't look up at the lane again.
pairs.hanzi: 林照从他身后绕过去，没再抬头看那条巷。
